open_points.subject: Project anonymisation after restore
open_points.text: R0-89 says “every other mark carries the instant of its repetition”, while M01 says an anonymised Project keeps “its `project_id`, its status, that mark and its artifact pointers and nothing else” and that every instant is gone.
open_points.question: After anonymisation is repeated following a restore, does the Project itself carry the repetition instant, or is that instant held only by the new audit entry?
options: The Project carries an anonymisation instant.
The Project keeps only the anonymised mark; the audit entry alone carries the instant.
open_points.default_guess: The Project keeps only the mark, with the repetition instant in the audit entry.

open_points.subject: Identities recreated after restore
open_points.text: R0-89 says “Projects, Customers, rooms and pointers first made after the backup are made again by the ordinary actions, with new identities”, but also says a repeated import mints new `customer_ref`s only “for the Customers it makes”, while State 0 and State 1 require the import to keep imported project, room and pointer identities.
open_points.question: Does “first made after the backup” cover records introduced into the lost store by the import, or only records originally created there through ordinary create, record, add and publish actions?
options: Only ordinarily created records receive new identities; a repeated import again preserves imported project, room and pointer ids while minting new refs for Customers it makes.
Every record introduced after the backup receives a new identity, including imported projects, rooms and pointers.
Imported records preserve their identities only when the repeated import is used; recreating them through ordinary actions gives them new identities.
open_points.default_guess: It covers only ordinarily created records; the repeated import preserves imported project, room and pointer ids and remints only the Customer refs it originally minted.

open_points.subject: Unreconstructable records created after the backup
open_points.text: R0-89 says records “first made after the backup are made again by the ordinary actions”, but its fallback says an unreconstructable fact “stays as the backup holds it”; the backup holds no state at all for a record first created after it.
open_points.question: What happens when a post-backup Project, Customer, Room or ArtifactPointer cannot be recreated because the owner no longer has the facts required by its ordinary creation action?
options: The record remains lost and the governance records that it could not be recreated.
Registry creates a partial replacement despite the ordinary action's required facts.
The owner must reconstruct every required fact before recovery can be considered complete.
open_points.default_guess: The record remains lost, because ordinary actions cannot create a partial invalid model, and the governance records the loss.
